72537-divvy-up.title: Divvy Up
72537-divvy-up.creator: Unknown
72537-divvy-up.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Rifle stocks were slapped in brisk unison as the weapons were brought down from the aim position through port to order arms. A trickle of sweat rolled across the bridge of Hardesty's nose. A bus rumbled by two blocks east, on what was left of Lexington Avenue. Hardesty wondered if the driver's union sanctioned passenger trapping. He had once traveled ten extra blocks on a bus which had slowed down without stopping at the designated spots.

arxiv-1904-03383.title: On the Representation of Partially Specified Implementations and its Application to the Optimization of Linear Algebra Kernels on GPU
arxiv-1904-03383.creator: Ulysse Beaugnon, Basile Clément, Nicolas Tollenaere, Albert Cohen
arxiv-1904-03383.description: Abstract Traditional optimizing compilers rely on rewrite rules to iteratively apply program transformations. This iterative approach hides optimization opportunities behind intermediate transformation steps. For instance, vectorization can only be applied to the innermost loop in a nest: one must first perform a loop interchange before even considering vectorization of an outer loop.

arxiv-1905-03997.title: Search for a correlation between the UHECRs measured by the Pierre Auger Observatory and the Telescope Array and the neutrino candidate events from IceCube and ANTARES
arxiv-1905-03997.creator: \firstname J. \lastname Aublin, \firstname A. \lastname Coleiro, \firstname A. \lastname Kouchner for the ANTARES Collaboration \firstname I. \lastname Al Samarai, \firstname A. \lastname Barbano, \firstname T. \lastname Montaruli \firstname L. \lastname Schumacher \firstname C. \lastname Wiebusch f
arxiv-1905-03997.description: Abstract High-energy neutrinos are expected to be produced by the interaction of accelerated particles near the acceleration sites. For this reason, it is interesting to search for correlation in the arrival directions of ultra-high energy cosmic rays (UHECRs) and HE neutrinos.

arxiv-2012-06024.title: Robustness and Transferability of Universal Attacks on Compressed Models
arxiv-2012-06024.creator: Alberto G. Matachana, Kenneth T. Co, Luis Muñoz-González, David Martinez, Emil C. Lupu
arxiv-2012-06024.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Alberto G. Matachana, Kenneth T. Co, Luis Muñoz-González, David Martinez, Emil C. Lupu. Neural network compression methods like pruning and quantization are very effective at efficiently deploying Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) on edge devices. However, DNNs remain vulnerable to adversarial examples–inconspicuous inputs that are specifically designed to fool these models. In particular, Universal Adversarial Perturbations (UAPs), are a powerful class of adversarial attacks which create adversarial perturbations that can generalize across a large set of inputs.

arxiv-2206-05864.title: Gaia Data Release 3: Astrophysical parameters inference system (Apsis) I - methods and content overview
arxiv-2206-05864.creator: O.L. Creevey, R. Sordo, F. Pailler, Y. Frémat, U. Heiter, F. Thévenin, R. Andrae, M. Fouesneau, A. Lobel, C.A.L. Bailer-Jones, D. Garabato, I. Bellas-Velidis, E. Brugaletta, A. Lorca, C. Ordenovic, P.A. Palicio, L.M. Sarro, L. Delchambre, R. Drimmel, J. Rybizki, G. Torralba Elipe, A.J. Korn, A. Reci
arxiv-2206-05864.description: Abstract Gaia Data Release 3 contains a wealth of new data products for the community. Astrophysical parameters are a major component of this release. They were produced by the Astrophysical parameters inference system (Apsis) within the Gaia Data Processing and Analysis Consortium.

arxiv-2210-03117.title: MaPLe: M ulti-mod a l P rompt Le arning
arxiv-2210-03117.creator: Muhammad Uzair Khattak, Hanoona Rasheed, Muhammad Maaz, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan
arxiv-2210-03117.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Muhammad Uzair Khattak, Hanoona Rasheed, Muhammad Maaz, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan. Pre-trained vision-language (V-L) models such as CLIP have shown excellent generalization ability to downstream tasks. However, they are sensitive to the choice of input text prompts and require careful selection of prompt templates to perform well. Inspired by the Natural Language Processing (NLP) literature, recent CLIP adaptation approaches learn prompts as the textual inputs to fine-tune CLIP for downstream tasks.

arxiv-2212-12799.title: A Comprehensive Study of Gender Bias in Chemical Named Entity Recognition Models
arxiv-2212-12799.creator: Xingmeng Zhao, Ali Niazi, Anthony Rios
arxiv-2212-12799.description: Abstract Chemical named entity recognition (NER) models are used in many downstream tasks, from adverse drug reaction identification to pharmacoepidemiology. However, it is unknown whether these models work the same for everyone. Performance disparities can potentially cause harm rather than the intended good. This paper assesses gender-related performance disparities in chemical NER systems.

arxiv-2302-09436.title: Rarefied Thue-Morse Sums Via Automata Theory and Logic
arxiv-2302-09436.creator: Jeffrey Shallit
arxiv-2302-09436.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jeffrey Shallit. Let t ⁡ ( n ) t(n) denote the number of 1 1 -bits in the base- 2 2 representation of n n , taken modulo 2 2 . We show how to prove the classic conjecture of Leo Moser, on the rarefied sum ∑ 0 ≤ i < n ( − 1 ) t ⁡ ( 3 ​ i ) \sum_{0\leq i<n}(-1)^{t(3i)} , using tools from automata theory and logic.

arxiv-2305-09714.title: An empirical study of dust properties at the earliest epochs
arxiv-2305-09714.creator: Joris Witstok, Gareth C. Jones, Roberto Maiolino, Renske Smit, and Raffaella Schneider
arxiv-2305-09714.description: Abstract We present an empirical analysis of the properties of dust-continuum emission in a sample of 17 galaxies in the early Universe ( 4 < z < 8 4<z<8 ) with well-sampled far-infrared (FIR) spectral energy distributions (SEDs) compiled from the literature.

arxiv-2306-00619.title: General SIS diffusion process with indirect spreading pathways on a hypergraph
arxiv-2306-00619.creator: Shaoxuan Cui, Fangzhou Liu, Hildeberto Jardón-Kojakhmetov, Ming Cao
arxiv-2306-00619.description: Abstract Conventional graphs captures pairwise interactions; by contrast, higher-order networks (hypergraphs, simplicial complexes) are introduced to the interactions involving more parties, which has been rapidly applied to characterize a growing number of complex real systems. It becomes apparent that higher-order interactions give rise to new challenges for the rigorous analysis of dynamics on a higher-order network.

arxiv-2309-17186.title: Unaware, Unfunded and Uneducated: A Systematic Review of SME Cybersecurity DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX CCS: General and reference Surveys and overviews CCS: Applied computing Business-IT alignment CCS: Applied computing IT governance CCS: Security and privacy Social aspects of security and privacy CCS: Soc
arxiv-2309-17186.creator: Carlos Rombaldo Junior, Ingolf Becker, Shane Johnson
arxiv-2309-17186.description: Abstract . Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) are pivotal in the global economy, accounting for over 90% of businesses and 60% of employment worldwide. Despite their significance, SMEs have been disregarded from cybersecurity initiatives, rendering them ill-equipped to deal with the growing frequency, sophistication, and destructiveness of cyber-attacks.

arxiv-2310-02876.title: Hate Speech Detection in Limited Data Contexts using Synthetic Data Generation DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation emai; Aug 16–19, 2023; Cape Town, SA Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06 CCS: Social and professional t
arxiv-2310-02876.creator: Aman Khullar, Daniel Nkemelu, Cuong V. Nguyen, Michael L. Best
arxiv-2310-02876.description: Abstract . A growing body of work has focused on text classification methods for detecting the increasing amount of hate speech posted online. This progress has been limited to only a select number of highly-resourced languages causing detection systems to either under-perform or not exist in limited data contexts.

arxiv-2403-18076.title: Magnetars as Powering Sources of Gamma-Ray Burst Associated Supernovae, and Unsupervised Clustering of Cosmic Explosions 2024 Magnetars as Powering Sources of Gamma-Ray Burst Associated Supernovae, and Unsupervised Clustering of Cosmic Explosions – 7
arxiv-2403-18076.creator: Amit Kumar ; Kaushal Sharma ; Jozsef Vinkó ; Danny Steeghs ; Benjamin Gompertz ; Joseph Lyman ; Raya Dastidar ; Avinash Singh ; Kendall Ackley ; Miika Pursiainen
arxiv-2403-18076.description: Abstract We present the semi-analytical light curve modelling of 13 supernovae associated with gamma-ray bursts (GRB-SNe) along with two relativistic broad-lined (Ic-BL) SNe without GRBs association (SNe 2009bb and 2012ap), considering millisecond magnetars as central-engine-based power sources for these events.

arxiv-2411-10284.title: Optimal Capacity Modification for Stable Matchings with Ties Thanks: A preliminary version [ 31 ] of this work appeared in the proceedings of the 34th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI) 2025
arxiv-2411-10284.creator: Keshav Ranjan, Meghana Nasre, Prajakta Nimbhorkar
arxiv-2411-10284.description: Abstract We consider the Hospitals/Residents ( HR ) problem in the presence of ties in hospital preferences. Among the three notions of stability, namely weak stability, strong stability, and super-stability, we focus on the notion of strong stability. Strong stability has many desirable properties, both theoretically and in practice; however, its existence is not guaranteed.

arxiv-2502-08150.title: Force Matching with Relativistic Constraints: A Physics-Inspired Approach to Stable and Efficient Generative Modeling
arxiv-2502-08150.creator: Yang Cao, Bo Chen, Xiaoyu Li, Yingyu Liang, Zhizhou Sha, Zhenmei Shi, Zhao Song, Mingda Wan
arxiv-2502-08150.description: Abstract This paper introduces Force Matching (ForM), a novel framework for generative modeling that represents an initial exploration into leveraging special relativistic mechanics to enhance the stability of the sampling process. By incorporating the Lorentz factor, ForM imposes a velocity constraint, ensuring that sample velocities remain bounded within a constant limit.

arxiv-2505-17474.title: Equivalence of Conjectures on Heavenly Elliptic Curves
arxiv-2505-17474.creator: Cam McLeman, Christopher Rasmussen
arxiv-2505-17474.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Cam McLeman, Christopher Rasmussen. Heavenly abelian varieties are abelian varieties defined over number fields that exhibit constrained ℓ \ell -adic Galois representations for some rational prime ℓ \ell . At the ICMS Workshop held in November 2024, we presented evidence for two finiteness conjectures around the distribution of heavenly elliptic curves over quadratic number fields, one in terms of isomorphism classes of curves, and a second in terms of quadratic fields which admit heavenly elliptic curves. We prove these two conjectures are equivalent.

arxiv-2507-08384.title: Smelly, Dense, and Spreaded: The O bject D etection for O lfactory R eferences (ODOR) Dataset Journal: arXiv preprint
arxiv-2507-08384.creator: Mathias Zinnen, Prathmesh Madhu, Inger Leemans, Peter Bell, Azhar Hussian, Hang Tran, Ali Hürriyetoğlu, Andreas Maier, Vincent Christlein
arxiv-2507-08384.description: Abstract Real-world applications of computer vision in the humanities require algorithms to be robust against artistic abstraction, peripheral objects, and subtle differences between fine-grained target classes. Existing datasets provide instance-level annotations on artworks but are generally biased towards the image centre and limited with regard to detailed object classes.

arxiv-2508-13923.title: Hunting for new glitches in LIGO data using community science
arxiv-2508-13923.creator: E Mackenzie 1, C P L Berry 1, G Niklasch 2,3, B Téglás 2, C Unsworth 2, K Crowston 4, D Davis 5 and A K Katsaggelos 6,7
arxiv-2508-13923.description: Abstract Data from ground-based gravitational-wave detectors like LIGO contain many types of noise. Glitches are short bursts of non-Gaussian noise that may hinder our ability to identify or analyse gravitational-wave signals. They may have instrumental or environmental origins, and new types of glitches may appear following detector changes.

arxiv-2509-20421.title: Formal Verification of Legal Contracts: A Translation-based Approach
arxiv-2509-20421.creator: Reiner Hähnle, Cosimo Laneve, Adele Veschetti
arxiv-2509-20421.description: Abstract Stipula is a domain-specific programming language designed to model legal contracts with enforceable properties, especially those involving asset transfers and obligations. This paper presents a methodology to formally verify the correctness of Stipula contracts through translation into Java code annotated with Java Modeling Language specifications. As a verification backend, the deductive verification tool KeY is used.

pmc-10491784.title: A study of allergen detection panel in Guangzhou, southern China based on real-world data from the past 7 years
pmc-10491784.creator: Haisheng Hu, Huimin Huang, Chenxi Liao, Aoli Li, Teng Zhang, Xueqing Liang, Baoqing Sun
pmc-10491784.description: This study aims to reduce the cost of allergen testing for Guangzhou, China by limiting the number of allergens for which patients are tested, and provide a testing panel to improve diagnostic and therapeutic efficiency. This retrospective study of real-world data from 2012 to 2019 included 39,570 patients with suspected allergies in Guangzhou, southern China.

pmc-11494539.title: Additional left atrial plication improves postoperative cardiovascular events in atrial functional mitral regurgitation
pmc-11494539.creator: Yosuke Takahashi, Akimasa Morisaki, Yoshito Sakon, Kenta Nishiya, Goki Inno, Takumi Kawase, Yukihiro Nishimoto, Munehide Nagao, Kazuki Noda, Takanobu Aoyama, Toshihiko Shibata
pmc-11494539.description: BackgroundLeft atrial (LA) plication is a procedure used to correct an LA that expands posteriorly due to remodeling. This study aimed to determine the efficacy of additional LA plication in reducing postoperative cardiovascular events (CVEs) after mitral valve (MV) repair in atrial functional mitral regurgitation (MR) patients.

pmc-11546706.title: Therapeutic Contribution of Tau-Binding Thiazoloflavonoid Hybrid Derivatives Against Glioblastoma Using Pharmacological Approach in 3D Spheroids
pmc-11546706.creator: Emmanuelle T Relave, Rayane Hedna, Attilio Di Maio, François Devred, Hervé Kovacic, Maxime Robin, Gilles Breuzard, Mario Costa
pmc-11546706.description: Growing evidence has unveiled the pathological significance of Tau in many cancers, including the most aggressive and lethal brain tumor glioblastoma multiform (GBM). In this regard, we have recently examined the structure–activity relationship of a new series of seventeen 2-aminothiazole-fused to flavonoid hybrid compounds (TZF) on Tau-overexpressing GBM cells.

pmc-13099170.title: Longitudinal Study of Frailty Phenotype in Relation to Chronic Kidney Disease Incidence
pmc-13099170.creator: Yong‐Xiang Ruan, Da‐Chuan Guo, Wen‐Hao Liu, Jia‐Man Ou, Qi Guo, Jing‐Wei Gao, Yang‐Wei Cai, Mao‐Xiong Wu, Xiao‐Tian Liang, Jie‐Wen Cai, Pin‐Ming Liu, Jing‐Feng Wang, Hai‐Feng Zhang, Yang‐Xin Chen
pmc-13099170.description: BackgroundThe longitudinal relationship between frailty phenotype and CKD development, and the modifying role of genetic CKD risk in this association, remains unclear. Research on simple, noninvasive and quantifiable CKD prediction models incorporating frailty is limited.MethodsWe analysed 214 502 CKD‐free participants from the UK Biobank cohort.

pmc-13316938.title: Introduction of regioselective bacterial heme oxygenases into Arabidopsis hy1-1 supports the retrograde heme signaling hypothesis
pmc-13316938.creator: Mihoko Takenoya, Takayuki Shimizu, Keita Miyake, Tatsuru Masuda
pmc-13316938.description: Heme is synthesized in the plastid and metabolized to phytochromobilin (PΦB) in 2 enzymatic steps: heme oxygenase (HO) and PΦB synthase (HY2). In Arabidopsis thaliana (Arabidopsis), HO1/HY1/GUN2 predominantly functions for heme catabolism among the HO isoforms. Our previous study demonstrated that HO1 localization is altered in plastids or in the cytosol due to transcriptional start-site regulation.

pmc-13608394.title: Effect of Delignification Process on the Properties of Barley-Straw Pulp and Paper
pmc-13608394.creator: Kateřina Hájková, Josef Bárta, Ida Skotnicová
pmc-13608394.description: Highlights •Barley straw was converted into pulp using three distinct delignification processes.•Under the tested conditions, the peracetic-acid treatment gave the highest yield and the lowest Kappa number.•The same treatment produced the highest tear index, burst index, and ISO brightness among the tested variants.•Paper properties differed markedly despite relatively similar beating degrees.

pmc-13617534.title: Surveillance of West Nile virus infections in humans and animals in Europe, monthly report – data submitted up to 3 September 2026
pmc-13617534.creator: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC), European Food Safety Authority (EFSA)
pmc-13617534.description: As part of their One Health activities, the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) and the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) jointly conduct surveillance of West Nile virus (WNV) infections in humans, equids and birds and assess the epidemiological situation in Europe. This surveillance informs public health and veterinary authorities and supports timely prevention and control measures.
